claims.claim: with a discount if your ready to buy
claims.evidence: This is a negotiation statement; no photo evidence.

risks.risk: Wrong gearbox model/variant (M272 claim may not match the actual transmission type/ratio/variant).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the gearbox identification plate/label (part number + transmission code) and/or the sticker with model/serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the worst-case mismatch risk: treat as not confirmed correct for your vehicle (so value reduced accordingly).

risks.risk: Not actually complete (missing internal/external parts or mismatched converter/cover).
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo of all included parts (converter, flex plate, sensors/solenoids, valve body, bolts, harness connectors) plus a checklist photo showing each item present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: assume missing parts).

risks.risk: Damage from prior failure (cracked housing, worn gears, metal shavings, bearing failure).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of wear points: gear teeth condition, bearing surfaces, housing cracks, and any scoring; plus a photo of the inside with good lighting.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/needs overhaul (worst case: not guaranteed good).

risks.risk: Converter/torque converter condition unknown (slippage, internal damage).
risks.proof: A photo of the converter serial/label (if present) and close-ups of the converter mounting surfaces; ideally a video showing it spins freely without grinding.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as converter condition unknown (worst case: assume may be faulty).

risks.risk: Fluid contamination / metal debris inside (common after gearbox failure).
risks.proof: A photo/video showing the inside after draining (if possible) and any visible debris; also ask for whether it was flushed and what caused the failure.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as contaminated/unknown history (worst case: assume needs full service).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the gearbox identification plate/label showing the transmission code and part number (not just the housing).
Photos of every included component laid out (converter, valve body/solenoids, sensors, harness connectors, bolts/fasteners).
Close-up photos of any stamped markings on the housing and the converter mounting area.
Video of the gearbox input/output shafts turning smoothly (no grinding) and a quick shake test for abnormal play.
Tell the exact vehicle make/model/year and engine/transmission code it came from (and confirm compatibility).
response.reason: The seller claims 'Complete gearbox M272', but the photos do not show any readable gearbox identification to confirm the exact model/variant or completeness. Without that, a safe worst-case price cannot be determined.
